task: Fix Google Search Console indexing cleanup issues reported for https://www.vishomecarpet.com
approvedBy: Site owner request on 2026-08-21 to fix the GSC indexing issue screenshots one by one
notes: Existing URLs and UI styling are preserved. This change audits and fixes GSC-reported index coverage noise by redirecting non-native locale-prefixed duplicate URLs to their canonical English paths, replacing internal links to redirecting URLs with final destinations, keeping canonical cleanup for query-parameter inquiry URLs, and removing non-HTML AI/TXT/JSON files from the XML page sitemap while keeping the files live for crawlers.
